title: ynh sensors show --format json
description: Output of `ynh sensors show <harness> <name> --format json`. One sensor resolved into a self-contained payload: a named focus reference is expanded from the harness's top-level focus map, so a consumer never has to look one up separately. Distinct from `cli/sensors`, which summarises the whole declared set. Envelope retrofit deferred, matching the other Phase 3 commands.

Focus.description: A focus, expanded. `inline` says where it came from: true when the sensor declared it in place, false when it was resolved from the harness's focus map. The prompt is present either way, which is the point of resolving.

name.description: The focus's name. Absent for an inline focus, which has none.

profile.description: Profile the focus applies, when it names one.

inline.description: True when declared inside the sensor rather than referenced by name. Inline focuses are scoped to their sensor and do not appear in the harness's top-level focus list.

Source.description: Strict one-of: exactly one of files, command or focus is set. Which one decides what running the sensor means — execute, read artifacts, or hand a prompt to an agent runtime ynh does not own.

format.description: Declared output format. Freeform by design — ynh does not parse sensor output, so this is a hint to the consumer, not a contract ynh enforces.

channel.description: Where the result appears. Inferred from the source kind when not declared: stdout+exit for a command, files for a files source, stdout for a focus.

path.description: Where the result is written, when the sensor declares one.

category.description: Fowler bucket: maintainability, architecture or behaviour. Free metadata for loop-driver triage.

role.description: Role hint: regular, convergence-verifier or stuck-recovery. Absent means regular.
